name: baseline-model
encoder: Uni-Sign pose-only (WLASL ISLR checkpoint): part-wise ST-GCN + mT5-base encoder, frozen
pooling: mean over frames of the mT5 encoder states, L2-normalised (768-d)
retrieval: mean of the top-2 instance cosines per concept

variants.zeroshot: frozen encoder, bank of Thai clips
variants.adapted: + residual MLP adapter (768-1024-768, CosFace on train signers)
